title: Module sections component on the standard resolution
statement: For a scheme X, an O_X-module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the fixed injective resolution I [def-sp-injective-resolutions] identified with injectiveResolution F, degree p and module cohomology class x [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], the common-resolution abelian-sections comparison [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-naturality] evaluated at x equals the inverse acyclic-resolution comparison applied to the exact-forgetting module-resolution comparison a at x. The defining equation for a and the quasi-isomorphism of the forgotten augmentation are supplied. This concerns only module cohomology and abelian derived sections; no Ext source-change or b comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tags 015E and 03FD; corresponding factor of the explicit comparison in ModuleCohomologyExtResolutionNaturality.

proof.text: Let s be the component of resolutionSectionsNatIso and c the acyclic-resolution isomorphism. First prove s followed by c equals a: substitute hI and ha, evaluate NatIso.ofComponents at F, and expand resolutionSectionsObjIso and resolutionForgetObjIso. sectionHomologyIso is the identity, so associativity and inverse-hom cancellation leave exactly a. A generic isomorphism identity then gives s.hom(x)=c.inv(a.hom(x)). Proof irrelevance identifies the supplied quasi-isomorphism and acyclicity proofs. This holds in every degree, including zero, for zero coefficients and empty schemes.
